content.title: US FDA declines to approve Scholar Rock's muscle weakness drug; shares fall
content.summary: (Reuters) -Scholar Rock said on Tuesday the U.S. health regulator has declined to approve its drug for a rare neuromuscular disease citing issues at a third-party manufacturing facility, sending the company's shares down 12% in premarket trading.  Scholar Rock is banking on apitegromab to drive its growth and profitability.  The drug is being tested as a treatment for spinal muscular atrophy and muscle preservation in obesity.
